source_registry.raw_capture_status: connector-retrieved job log; byte-complete raw archive and SHA-256 receipt not captured
limitations: This is one workflow execution, not a comprehensive test of every platform API or account.
The GitHub App variables were empty in this job; this does not prove repository-level secrets do not exist, only that they were not available to this run.
A Databricks HTTP 403 does not distinguish token validity from workspace, warehouse, principal or policy authorization.
The Hugging Face runtime stage is a point-in-time status and does not establish why the build failed.
The two successful source checks read GitHub main source, not the deployed Hugging Face Space revision.
The GitHub repository connector used by this research process is separate from the GitHub App integration probed by the workflow.

github_repository_connector.evidence: The connected GitHub integration successfully read the repository tree and PR metadata and created/verified commits on explicitly named PR branches during this run.
github_repository_connector.scope: Repository operations through the connected GitHub integration.
github_repository_connector.distinction: This does not prove the scheduled GitHub App installation secrets are present or that the Pillars workflow can authenticate as a GitHub App.

github_app_pillars_probe.details: GITHUB_APP_ID, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY and GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ID were empty in run 41834374956.
github_app_pillars_probe.authentication: The current source code uses a read-only GET /app/installations/{id} probe and does not mint an installation access token.

workflow_observations.detail: Required GitHub App environment variables were not available to the scheduled job.
Databricks SQL Statements endpoint returned HTTP 403 for SELECT 1.
Hugging Face Space runtime reported stage=BUILD_ERROR.
GitHub main source marker was present; deployed Space revision was not inspected.
GitHub main source fiction scan was clean; deployed runtime was not inspected.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The GitHub App integration variables are not configured for, or not injected into, the scheduled workflow environment.
support: All three variables were empty in the workflow job log.
disconfirming_or_missing: The run cannot distinguish absent repository secrets from environment/secret-name scoping or workflow injection issues.
tests: Use an authorized repository administrator to verify secret names and environment scope without exposing values; rerun only after configuration is confirmed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The configured Databricks principal lacks permission for the SQL warehouse or SQL Statements API.
support: The read-only SELECT 1 request returned HTTP 403.
disconfirming_or_missing: The response body and principal/warehouse grant state were not captured; a workspace policy or token issue is also possible.
tests: Verify the service principal, workspace entitlements and warehouse CAN USE permission through authorized administration; rerun the same read-only query.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Hugging Face Space is not currently serving because its runtime is in BUILD_ERROR.
support: The public runtime endpoint returned stage=BUILD_ERROR.
disconfirming_or_missing: Build logs and the exact deployed commit were not inspected.
tests: Inspect public status again and, only through authorized owner access, review the Space build logs and deployed revision.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The previous source-check labels overstated what was verified because they read GitHub main rather than the deployed Hugging Face runtime.
support: The source functions fetched GitHub API/raw main URLs while the Space runtime probe was a separate GET.
disconfirming_or_missing: No deployed revision or source parity receipt was captured.
tests: Keep source checks explicitly named as repository-source checks; add a separate deployed-revision comparison only when a verifiable Space revision identifier is available.

data_quality.source_independence: single workflow run; no independent second publisher
data_quality.secret_handling: No secret values were retrieved, emitted or stored. Logs showed masked/empty environment values only.
data_quality.no_live_connection_claims: Only the GitHub repository connector was verified through actual repository operations. The other platform statuses are limited to the observations stated above.
data_quality.market_feature_eligibility: excluded; these are integration-health observations, not XRP market features.
